**Finding submitted: deviation (RENEWAL).**

- **Where:** Article IV (Term), paragraph p0049 — the renewal mechanic tied to the "Initial Period" defined there (36 months from the acceptance date).
- **Problem:** "The Agreement may be renewed for an additional period of seven (7) years at the option of the Licensor." A seven-year rollover exercisable unilaterally by the Vendor is in walk-away territory (automatic multi-year renewal with no Customer exit and no notice window at all), and there is no cap on renewal pricing. It also contradicts subsections II and III of the same Article, which contemplate extension only by mutual written agreement.
- **Redline (validated, preferred position):** renewal only by mutual written agreement, in successive 12-month periods, with any renewal fee increase capped at the lesser of CPI and 3%.
